hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was flipped from off to on at 22:07, and the newly enabled code path divides by zero on the account page. Error rate jumped from ~1% to 25-33% exactly as the flag's evaluations shifted from 100% off to 100% on, with no deploys in the preceding week.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-02T22:07:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
2026-09-02T22:08:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 34% over the last minute
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-08-26T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T22:08:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: a latent code defect in the account page's spend calculation was already deployed and merely exposed when the flag ramped; the underlying fault is the ZeroDivisionError in that code path rather than the toggle itself. Rolling the flag back would still mitigate.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-02T22:11:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-08-26T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-02T22:08:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Residual possibility that the errors are upstream-driven rather than flag-driven: UpstreamTimeout on payment authorization appears both before and during the incident. This does not explain the step change, since the pre-onset timeouts sustained only ~1% error rate.
